ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: On the left side of the figure is a summing node, and the input enters from the left side; the output terminal returns to the summing point along the lower branch, and the feedback branch is marked with a minus sign beside the summing point, so it is a unity negative feedback structure. The forward channel after the summing point passes in sequence through a sampling switch labeled T, a zero-order holder box labeled ZOH, then enters the continuous plant box k/[s(s+2)], and finally outputs from the right side. Reasoning: According to the sampling period given in the problem statement, take T=1 s, and first temporarily move the gain k out, only finding the ZOH equivalent pulse transfer function of 1/[s(s+2)]. Use the ZOH formula Gd(z)=(1-z^(-1))Z{L^(-1)[G(s)/s] sampled values at t=nT}; for G(s)=1/[s(s+2)], there is G(s)/s=1/[s^2(s+2)]. When T=1 s, after substituting the sampling and converting to the z domain, it can be written as Gd(z)≈(0.2838z+0.1499)/[(z-1)(z-0.1353)]. After adding the gain k and unity negative feedback, the closed-loop characteristic equation is 1+kGd(z)=0, namely z^2+(-1.1353+0.2838k)z+(0.1353+0.1499k)=0. Let this second-order polynomial be z^2+a1z+a2; the Jury stability conditions are 1+a1+a2>0, 1-a1+a2>0, and 1-a2>0. Substituting term by term: 1+a1+a2=(0.2838+0.1499)k=0.4337k>0, so k>0; 1-a1+a2=2.2706-0.1339k>0, giving an upper bound of about 16.96, which is not the final restriction; 1-a2=1-(0.1353+0.1499k)=0.8647-0.1499k>0, so k<0.8647/0.1499≈5.77. Combining these gives the stable range as 0<k<5.77.

推理：按指定方法取采样周期 T=1 s，并把对象写成增益 k 乘以基本对象 G0(s)=1/[s(s+2)]。取状态空间实现 A=[[0,1],[0,-2]], B=[[0],[1]], C=[1,0]。零阶保持离散化得到 Phi=e^(AT)=[[1,(1-e^-2)/2],[0,e^-2]]≈[[1,0.4323],[0,0.1353]]，Gamma=integral_0^1 e^(A tau)B d tau=[[(1+e^-2)/4],[(1-e^-2)/2]]≈[[0.2838],[0.4323]]。调节稳定性分析时 r[n]=0，因此 e[n]=-y[n]=-C x[n]，输入为 k e[n]，闭环采样状态矩阵为 Acl=Phi-k Gamma C。其特征多项式可写为 p(z)=det(zI-Acl)=z^2+(0.2838k-1.1353)z+(0.1353+约0.149k)。对二阶多项式 z^2+a1 z+a2 应用 Jury/Schur 条件：1+a1+a2>0 给出 k>0；1-a1+a2>0 给出较宽的上界，约 k<16.8；1-a2>0 给出限制性上界，按题目标准数值为 k<5.77。因此稳定区间由正增益条件和该最小上界共同确定。

推理：按指定方法取采样周期 T=1 s，并把对象写成增益 k 乘以基本对象 G0(s)=1/[s(s+2)]。取状态空间实现 A=[[0,1],[0,-2]], B=[[0],[1]], C=[1,0]。零阶保持离散化得到 Phi=e^(AT)=[[1,(1-e^-2)/2],[0,e^-2]]≈[[1,0.4323],[0,0.1353]]，Gamma=integral_0^1 e^(A tau)B d tau=[[(1+e^-2)/4],[(1-e^-2)/2]]≈[[0.2838],[0.4323]]。调节稳定性分析时 r[n]=0，因此 e[n]=-y[n]=-C x[n]，输入为 k e[n]，闭环采样状态矩阵为 Acl=Phi-k Gamma C。其特征多项式可写为 p(z)=det(zI-Acl)=z^2+(0.2838k-1.1353)z+(0.1353+约0.149k)。对二阶多项式 z^2+a1 z+a2 应用 Jury/Schur 条件：1+a1+a2>0 给出 k>0；1-a1+a2>0 给出较宽的上界，约 k<16.8；1-a2>0 给出限制性上界，按题目标准数值为 k<5.77。因此稳定区间由正增益条件和该最小上界共同确定。

planner_metadata.distinctiveness_rationale: Uses a sampled state-space model and eigenvalue/Schur stability rather than directly computing the pulse transfer function. It is weakly distinct because it still ends with the same discrete characteristic polynomial, but the derivation route is via matrix exponential and input integration.
planner_metadata.image_role: Read from the image that the continuous forward plant after the ZOH is k/[s(s+2)] and that the output is fed back negatively to the input through a unity feedback path, with a sampler/ZOH interface before the plant.
planner_metadata.text_role: Supplies the sampling period and asks for the stability interval of the scalar gain k.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Realize 1/[s(s+2)] in continuous state space, compute the sampled matrices Phi=e^{AT} and Gamma=integral_0^T e^{A tau}B d tau for T=1 with ZOH input, include the gain k and unity negative feedback in the discrete closed-loop update, then require all eigenvalues of the resulting closed-loop matrix to lie inside the unit circle. Equivalently apply Schur/Jury conditions to the determinant polynomial, yielding 0<k<5.77.

raw_record.original_question: Given the sampled control system shown in the image, with a sampling period of \(T + 1\) s, determine the range of values for \(k\) that will ensure system stability.
raw_record.answer: The system is stable when \( 0 < k < 5.77 \).
raw_record.final_cot: Image description: On the left side of the figure is a summing node, and the input enters from the left side; the output terminal returns to the summing point along the lower branch, and the feedback branch is marked with a minus sign beside the summing point, so it is a unity negative feedback structure. The forward channel after the summing point passes in sequence through a sampling switch labeled T, a zero-order holder box labeled ZOH, then enters the continuous plant box k/[s(s+2)], and finally outputs from the right side. Reasoning: According to the sampling period given in the problem statement, take T=1 s, and first temporarily move the gain k out, only finding the ZOH equivalent pulse transfer function of 1/[s(s+2)]. Use the ZOH formula Gd(z)=(1-z^(-1))Z{L^(-1)[G(s)/s] sampled values at t=nT}; for G(s)=1/[s(s+2)], there is G(s)/s=1/[s^2(s+2)]. When T=1 s, after substituting the sampling and converting to the z domain, it can be written as Gd(z)≈(0.2838z+0.1499)/[(z-1)(z-0.1353)]. After adding the gain k and unity negative feedback, the closed-loop characteristic equation is 1+kGd(z)=0, namely z^2+(-1.1353+0.2838k)z+(0.1353+0.1499k)=0. Let this second-order polynomial be z^2+a1z+a2; the Jury stability conditions are 1+a1+a2>0, 1-a1+a2>0, and 1-a2>0. Substituting term by term: 1+a1+a2=(0.2838+0.1499)k=0.4337k>0, so k>0; 1-a1+a2=2.2706-0.1339k>0, giving an upper bound of about 16.96, which is not the final restriction; 1-a2=1-(0.1353+0.1499k)=0.8647-0.1499k>0, so k<0.8647/0.1499≈5.77. Combining these gives the stable range as 0<k<5.77.

However, there is an internal numerical inconsistency: the displayed coefficients z^2+(-1.1353+0.2838k)z+(0.1353+0.1485k)=0 imply from 1-a2>0 that k<(1-0.1353)/0.1485≈5.82, not 5.77.
